mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id ASC, sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.parent_id ASC, m.sort ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT permission FROM sys_menu WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND permission IS NOT NULL AND permission != '' ORDER BY permission ASC
